title: The Beggar at the Ford
text: An old man sits on the stones of the ford with his hand out, patient as the river. The water runs around him and does not wet him. He has no feet, and when the light comes through the clouds you see that he has no shadow either.

options.label: Give him your bread, and do not look at his shadow.

outcomes.text: He eats slowly and blesses you in a language older than the kingdom.
He takes it and laughs, and his laugh follows you across the water.
He does not look up. Where you step past him the water turns cold as a grave, and the Leader's feet will not warm all day.

options.label: Take what he has. He cannot follow.

outcomes.text: Three coins, older than any king. Nobody will ask where they came from.
Three coins, and something comes with them.
